- Apparel return rates have reached 24%, per Brightline's 2026 retail returns logistics piece (https://blog.brightline.example/2026/returns).
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by roughly a fifth (20%).
- Companion piece (https://insights.brightline.example/returns/companion, accessed via free email registration with ingrid.reyes@northwind.example): reselling returned items within 10 days preserves most of the margin.
